description: Vision is faced with many challenges while trying to regain his memory and humanity.

episodes.description: Vision is living in Edinburgh, working at a local bar. His peaceful existence is interrupted when a bounty is placed on his head. Meanwhile, a mysterious grifter named Tommy Shepherd is troubled by disturbing memories of Westview.
episodes.title: No Strings

episodes.description: Vision, who is still being hunted by a mysterious force, learns of Tommy's existence and begins to question if this boy is truly his son. Vision returns to the remains of the bar in Edinburgh, and comes face to face with his unknown assailant.
episodes.title: Theseus

episodes.description: Vision and Tommy Shepherd join forces in order to survive while a terrifying killer strikes again.
episodes.title: Reboot

episodes.description: As Vision confronts a new enemy, Ultron and Tommy Shepherd come face to face.
episodes.title: Malware

episodes.description: Ultron and Jocasta join forces; Lisa comes to Vision's aid to help him evade capture.
episodes.title: Firewall

episodes.description: Vision and Paladin form an uneasy alliance as Thomas finally learns the truth about his past.
episodes.title: Deadlock

episodes.description: Vision and Ultron's twisted relationship comes undone.
